sentences.translation: Muthũnga wa Kirinyaga 90% ya githimo ĩrĩa kĩĩte wa githaka ĩrĩ ũcio.
sentences.reference: Kũria Kirinyaga gĩcunjĩ kĩa mĩrongo kenda harĩ igana kĩa magetha marĩa marathĩtwo nĩmerĩgĩrĩirwo

sentences.source: Wheat performed well in most parts of Narok but was heavily affected by Quelea Quelea birds.
sentences.translation: Mĩngĩ wa githũnga ĩũtũrĩre mũtuũka wa Narok nĩ ĩngĩ ĩngĩ ĩngĩ ĩrĩrĩrĩrĩ mũthũnga mũtuũka wa Quelea Quelea.
sentences.reference: Ngano yari na magetha  mega icigo nyingĩ cia Narok  no nyoni cia [cs] Quelea[cs]  nĩciathũkangirie ngano mũno

sentences.source: Prepare a seedbed of width 1 m and a desirable length by removing farm soil from the seedbed to a depth of 30 cm and refill the 30 cm depression with sand.
sentences.translation: Thĩĩrĩra ngare nĩ 1 m, na ngare ũrĩa ũrĩ ngĩthaara na gĩthĩire mburu mũthiga wa kiruri 30 cm, na gĩthĩire ngare 30 cm ĩrĩ mũndu mũrĩĩra na mĩndu.
sentences.reference: Thondeka natharĩ ya wariĩ wa mita ĩmwe na uraihu ũrĩa wagĩrĩire na weherie tĩĩri ucio kũũma natharĩ-inĩ  nginya ũriku wa [cs] centimeter[cs] mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ũcoke  ũiyũrie [cs] centimeter[cs] icio mĩrongo ĩtatũ cia ũrikĩru na mũthanga

sentences.source: Capacity building of stakeholders in hides and skins in all 47 Counties
sentences.translation: Gũtihĩtĩrwa mũtano wa nginya wa gĩthĩĩra na gĩthĩĩra nĩ mũtu mũtu mũtatu mũthaga.
sentences.reference: Kũgaacĩrithia ũhoti wa arĩa marĩ na itemi maũndũ-inĩ ma njũa   kauntĩ-inĩ ciothe mĩrongo ĩna na  mũgwanja

sentences.source: An estimated 76% of the target area was realized during the season due to late onset of rains
sentences.translation: Mĩngĩĩri mũthĩ wa 76% wa thĩĩrĩrĩrĩte wa githũnga mũthũtieri mũĩĩte wa gũtũrĩte, ũrĩa nĩ gũtĩũta mũthĩ wa gĩthũnga.
sentences.reference: Gĩcunjĩ kĩa mĩrongo mũgwanja na ithathatũ  kwa igana kĩa gĩcigo kĩrĩa kĩarongoreirio kĩmera-inĩ kĩu nĩkĩo kĩahingire nĩũndũ wa mbura gũcererwo

sentences.source: In Kirinyaga, harvesting almost finalized in all farms.
sentences.translation: Muthũnga wa Kirinyaga nĩ ĩrĩ mũrĩre wa gĩtherĩ muothũtia mũtathi yaga.
sentences.reference: Kũria Kirinyaga magetha mothe nitamarĩkĩte mĩgũnda-inĩ yothe
